| Checksum vs Digital Signature | Checksum verifies integrity against a known value; signature can also establish publisher authenticity |
| Rate Limit vs Budget | Controls request frequency vs total usage or spending |

sections.title: Knowledge check
sections.body:
**Batch 6 assessment** · (0/5 answered)

**1. An agent makes unlimited model calls because it has no iteration limit. Which risk is this?**

- [ ] Model extraction

- [ ] Resource exhaustion

- [ ] Supply chain attack

- [ ] RBAC

**2. A user makes a few requests but consumes millions of tokens. Which control is especially relevant?**

- [ ] Token budget

- [ ] Password reset

- [ ] Document versioning

- [ ] Model checksum

**3. An attacker inserts malicious documents into a RAG knowledge base. What is this?**

- [ ] Model theft

- [ ] RAG poisoning

- [ ] JWT forgery

- [ ] Output moderation

**4. An attacker queries a public model API to build a substitute model. What is this?**

- [ ] Model extraction

- [ ] Data masking

- [ ] Rate limiting

- [ ] Human approval

**5. What does an SBOM provide?**

- [ ] A list of model responses

- [ ] A software component inventory

- [ ] A user access token

- [ ] A moderation score

Submit answers

sections.title: Practical assignment — Secure an enterprise AI platform
sections.body:
Design an architecture that protects:

1. A FastAPI application from request flooding.
2. An LLM provider from excessive token consumption.
3. A RAG knowledge base from malicious document uploads.
4. A proprietary model from unauthorized access and extraction.
5. Python dependencies and model artifacts from supply chain attacks.

Include rate limits, token budgets, document provenance, model integrity verification, dependency scanning and security monitoring.

# LLM Security — Module 1 Complete

(Module completed)

**30 / 30**

**30 security concepts covered across 6 batches**

Fundamentals · Prompt attacks · Data security · Agent security · Guardrails · Advanced security

# Next: Module 2 — LLM Gateway Engineering

Now we'll move from securing an individual LLM application to designing and operating a centralized LLM Gateway for production systems.
